name: Lumen for iCUE LINK
author: pxSean
description: A live reading in the bar (coolant temperature by default), with quick lighting, profile and AIO screen controls for Corsair iCUE LINK hardware. Requires the lumen daemon.

barWidget.description: Coolant temperature or another reading, fan speeds, and quick lighting, profile and AIO screen controls. Left click opens the panel, right click opens the Lumen TUI.

schema.label: Metric
schema.description: The reading shown next to the icon and at the top of the panel. coolant.temp = AIO coolant; cpu/gpu/igpu.temp = temperatures; .load = utilization; mem.used = system memory; gpu.vram = GPU memory used; gpu.power = GPU watts; pump/fans.rpm = speed; .duty = duty cycle. The GPU readings need an NVIDIA card.

schema.label: Show the metric in the bar
schema.description: Show the chosen metric next to the icon. Off shows the icon alone.
